published_ranges._enclosure: strong chemical odor when printing: use proper ventilation and air exchange at all times
published_ranges._notes: Atomic Filament's own product page (FR15U Black, AMS Compatible) gives 'Print temp 235 to 255C' and 'Bed Temp 115C +- 10C' (single value with tolerance; not entered as a bed range). Density, HDT, Vicat and drying are from SABIC CYCOLAC FR15U resin datasheets (the resin Atomic names on its product page), not a filament TDS. HDT at 1.82 MPa: 75°C. UL94 V-0/5VA rated resin. Drying time for FR15U was not captured (the sister grade FR15 Americas sheet lists 2-4 h). Earlier entry: Resin: SABIC CYCOLAC FR15U ABS, resin meets UL V-0. Atomic links SABIC's resin TDS, which could not be fetched (HTTP 406), so no density/HDT recorded (resin density is not the generic ABS SDS value). Sample coil page: ovality +/-0.05 mm or better.
